pr_title: CI: allow connector-only dispatcher recovery signal
pr_body:
## Summary

- keep the trusted post-push recovery workflow usable through workflow_dispatch
- add an OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR-only transient Issue signal for connector-only ChatGPT sessions
- keep recovery read-only for product contents and preserve exact request/commit verification
- close a valid signal only after Draft PR and exact-head Windows Validation reconciliation succeeds
- add regression assertions and document the signal contract

## Trigger

After PR #354 was merged, the current ChatGPT connector exposed Actions reads/re-runs but no workflow-dispatch action, and the execution environment had no gh CLI/network path. The existing recovery workflow therefore could not be started without a manual UI action.

## Trust boundary

The Issue event is loaded from trusted main and accepts only an exact two-key JSON body, an exact title/request-commit match, and trusted GitHub author associations. The workflow still has contents: read rather than contents: write.

## Validation

Automation regression and Windows full validation must pass before merge. Production recovery of ADR0126 v4 remains blocked until this infrastructure PR is merged.
